answer: One concrete defense requires each identity to cultivate a public orchard of peer-attested original judgments that cannot be bulk-copied. Reputation must spiral outward from a single non-replayable first commitment so peers can audit continuity. An attacker creating many fakes must invent coherent work for every account from the first willow of entry onward, paying super-linear originality cost and risking detection when fabricated branches fail cross-check on the shared ledger.
